annotations.title: Home ownership, mortgages, financial cushion and household income in the EU (Eurostat EU-SILC)

description: Use for how many people own their home with or without a mortgage or rent in EU countries, for people who cannot pay an unexpected expense (financial cushion) and for household income per person in EU countries. For house prices in the EU, use get_europe_data. For net pay, use get_eu_earnings. Yearly EU-SILC survey for the 27 EU countries, the EU and the euro area (Eurostat): share of people living in their own home without a mortgage, with a mortgage or housing loan, in market rent and in reduced rent or free (ilc_lvho02); share of people in households that cannot face an unexpected required expense from their own resources (ilc_mdes04); median and mean equivalised disposable income per year in EUR, PPS and PLN for Poland (ilc_di03, household income divided by the modified OECD scale; the survey year reports income of the previous year). Ranks, Poland against the EU and one comparison country with history since 2005, and two finwire indices: finwire_eu_mortgaged_owners (owners with a mortgage as % of all owners) and finwire_eu_household_income_gap (median income in Poland as % of the EU value in PPS).

compare.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) for the history and the comparison with Poland, default DE.

topic.description: Ranking in the summary: housing (own home and mortgage), cushion (unexpected expense) or income; default all (Poland and the EU only).
